name: Workspace Shape Indicator
author: 1ternal
description: Minimal workspace indicator drawn as clean native vector shapes: dots, squares, diamonds, or bars.

barWidget.description: Minimal workspace indicator drawn as clean native vector shapes: dots, squares, diamonds, or bars.

schema.label: Shape
schema.description: dots: circle. square: cube. diamond: rhombus. bar: horizontal pill.

schema.label: Color scheme
schema.description: theme: follows bar foreground palette. monotone: pure neutral black-and-white grayscale.

schema.label: Density
schema.description: Slot width and padding: compact, normal, or relaxed.

schema.label: Base workspaces
schema.description: Minimum workspace slots 1..N, always shown (ignored when hideEmpty is true). Grows contiguously to the highest workspace in use, so a slot's position always equals its workspace number.

schema.label: Hide empty
schema.description: Hide unoccupied workspaces. When true, shrink to occupied workspaces plus the focused one, so bar width changes as windows open and close. Default false keeps the base 1..N slots shown with stable mouse-click targets; it still grows when a higher workspace is used.

schema.label: Occupied idle opacity
schema.description: Opacity of idle workspaces with windows (empty workspaces dim further). Unset follows the system Style.normalBorderAlpha token; any explicit value pins, even one equal to a theme default. To unpin, delete the key from shell.json or run: omarchy bar set io.github.1ternal.wsi dim null --json.

schema.label: Scroll to switch
schema.description: Wheel over the widget moves between workspaces.
